title: chore: Honey Census pays 5 Quest Pollen and needs more than 2 Pollen bought
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Lower the Honey Census reward from 10 to 5 Quest Pollen
- Require more than 2 Pollen bought in total (Stripe checkouts + paid auto top-ups + Polar orders). The smallest pack (2 Pollen) alone no longer qualifies; 9 farmed accounts each bought exactly that pack to unlock the reward
- Form and quest descriptions state the new rule
- Rewards already earned keep their amount. The form text changes as soon as this merges; the quest code ships with the next production promotion

Test: `npx vitest run test/quests.test.ts --testNamePattern="Honey Census"` passes (2 Pollen bought: no reward; 7 bought: 5 Quest Pollen).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Counting the honey jars
gist.blurb: Honey Census counts Pollen bought across Stripe checkouts, paid auto top-ups, and Polar orders. A total above 2 qualifies for its 5 Quest Pollen reward; rewards already earned keep their original amount.
gist.summary: Honey Census sets its reward at 5 Quest Pollen instead of 10 and requires more than 2 Pollen bought in total across Stripe checkouts, paid auto top-ups, and Polar orders, while preserving previously earned rewards.
gist.impact: A combined purchase total above 2 Pollen qualifies for 5 Quest Pollen; an exact total of 2 does not, and previously earned rewards retain their original amounts.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Honey Census as a cozy garden counting table: jars from three purchase paths feed a shared tally, with a small sign reading “>2” and a reward jar marked “5.” Polli, wearing tiny accountant glasses, checks the tally beside flowers and an already-filled jar left undisturbed.
